skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5 combo strikes to a single back-row target for 42% ATK DMG, and inflicts [Weaken] on the target (ATK decreased by 40% for 2 turns).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5 combo strikes to a single back-row target for 53% ATK DMG, and inflicts [Weaken] on the target (ATK decreased by 50% for 2 turns).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. The final strike deals splash damage equal to 40% ATK to enemies around the target; a Critical Strike increases the splash damage by 1x, stacking up to 2x.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. The final strike deals splash damage equal to 45% ATK to enemies around the target; a Critical Strike increases the splash damage by 1x, stacking up to 3x.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. The final strike deals splash damage equal to 48% ATK to enemies around the target; a Critical Strike increases the splash damage by 1x, stacking up to 3x.

effects.desc: Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
